degrees_of_freedom: one binary spin per lattice site; no positions, no volume, no particle-number channel
contrast: the sibling packages cuni_N256 and cuag_N108 in the same directory are HYBRID: their state is (u, w, s) with continuous displacements u and log-volume w alongside the species labels s.  Here the state is s alone.
cutoff_rule: largest pairwise distance in the figure (the rule of the CLEASE version that fitted these ECIs; current CLEASE uses twice the distance from the figure's centroid and would enumerate a different, smaller orbit set)
eci_source: Damewood, Schwalbe-Koda, Gomez-Bombarelli, npj Comput. Mater. 8, 61 (2022); code release learningmatter-mit/Segal
convention: s_i = +1 is the spin-up element; c = fraction of spin-up sites; H(s) = E(s) - (dmu/2) sum_i s_i, so dmu is the physical chemical-potential difference
